    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro a b hr μ
  constructor <;> intro s ht <;> cases hr <;> rename_i h
  case' left.choice => cases ht
  case' right.choice => cases ht
  all_goals
    first
    | exact ⟨_, .choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | first
      | refine (h.follow_fst ‹_›).imp ?_
      | refine (h.follow_snd ‹_›).imp ?_
      rintro t ⟨ht, hh⟩
      refine ⟨?_, .bisim hh⟩
      first | exact ht | exact .choiceL ht

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro a b hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s ht <;> cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hh⟩ := (by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht)
      exact ⟨t, .choiceL ht, .bisim hh⟩
    | choiceR ht => exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    grind only [→ Bisimilarity.follow_fst, → Bisimilarity.follow_snd, ChoiceBisim.bisim]
